description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a set of tests related to disabling HTTP Git operations, including initializing repositories, pushing commits, and testing HTTP transport configurations.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success if the commands inside pass.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the commands inside fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the command output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests the protocol-specific behavior of git over HTTP.
